summary: The deck has a clear visual system (the mountain-path metaphor, a consistent palette and good figure slides such as the memorization and subtopic charts). The most important fix is the section slides, which hold unreadable miniature slide thumbnails, and the sparse text slides that leave much of the canvas empty.

slides.problem: The mountain-path graphic competes with the title. The circle labels are tiny (about 8pt) and unreadable from the back, and the empty placeholder boxes inside the circles look like unfinished wireframes. The title block is small and pushed into the top-left corner.

fix.note: Remove the empty boxes and the tiny labels, or enlarge the labels. Make the title larger and let the mountain act as quiet background decoration.

slides.problem: A miniature thumbnail of slide 3 sits inside the circle below the section title. It is unreadable, repeats content, and distracts from the section title.
Two tiny, illegible slide thumbnails sit in the lower half of the section circle. This is clutter, and the circle looks empty above them.
The thumbnails (a chart and a '50.3%' stat) in the section circle are unreadable and add noise.
Six tiny thumbnails fill the lower half of the circle, including the credits and workflow slides. They are illegible and make the section divider crowded.
The Fig. 1 screenshot is small, with body text of about 8pt equivalent, so it cannot be read from the back. The caption nearly touches the figure card and has a large gap below it.

fix.note: Enlarge the figure to fill the slide height, or crop to the key parts. Add spacing between the card and the caption.

slides.problem: The table occupies only the top half of the slide, leaving a large empty area. The header row has weak contrast and the rows are small. The 'Share' column shows 5% against an unexplained 47.5%, and the headline of 38.5B tokens is not visually emphasised.
The flow diagram sits in the upper-middle of the slide with empty space below. The text is mid-sized, and 'Few-shot prompt (4-shot on MATH)' breaks awkwardly as '4-/shot'.
The chart legend and axis labels are very small, and the bars use 11 similar purple-orange shades that are hard to tell apart from a distance. The caption sits tight against the card.

fix.note: Enlarge the figure and the legend, or highlight only Minerva 540B and the SOTA bars. Add space above the caption.

slides.problem: The big-number slide lacks context. The metric label ('Minerva 540B maj1@k on MATH') and the title are not shown, and the right half of the slide is empty. The contrast with 6.9% is not made visible.

The bullets are spread out with big uneven gaps. The last bullet wraps without a hanging indent, so its second line is misaligned with the first. There is no emphasis on the key numbers, and the right third of the slide is empty.
The chart text is small, and the middle panel's scatter is not explained on the slide. The caption is the only source reference and has no takeaway.

fix.note: Enlarge the figure, and add a short takeaway label under each panel, such as 'points on the diagonal = no memorization'.

slides.problem: The closing takeaways are plain small text with a lot of empty space below. Item 1 is a vague list of nouns, and item 3 is a negative statement with no clear framing as a limitation.

The credits text is small and sits in the top third of the slide, with the lower 60% empty. The figure IDs (fig1, tab2, tab4, tab5) are raw internal names, and the tables tab2, tab4 and tab5 are not used in the deck.

fix.find: Figures: fig1, fig4, fig5, tab1, tab2, tab4, tab5 from the documents above
fix.replace: Figures: Fig. 1, 4, 5 and Table 1 from the paper

slides.problem: The workflow slide is a meta slide that is not relevant to the paper's content. Its caption is long and wraps, leaving an orphaned '(sonnet)' on the second line.

fix.note: Shorten the caption to one line or move this slide to the appendix.
